class.name: LinearLayoutManager
class.brief_description: Lays items out in a single vertical column or horizontal row.
class.description:
LinearLayoutManager places items one after another along the scroll axis, supporting variable item heights. It is the default layout for a plain list.
[b]Horizontal list[/b]: [codeblock] var layout := LinearLayoutManager.new() layout.set_orientation(LinearLayoutManager.HORIZONTAL) recycler_view.set_layout(layout) [/codeblock]
Use [method set_reverse_layout] to start from the bottom / trailing edge (chat lists).

method.name: get_cached_item_count
method.description: Returns the number of cached items in the offset table (size - 1).

method.name: get_item_offset
method.description: Returns the starting coordinate of the item at [code]position[/code] in the accumulated offset table (0 when out of range).

method.name: set_orientation
method.description: Sets the layout direction: [constant VERTICAL] (default) or [constant HORIZONTAL].

constants.constant: Vertical orientation (one item per row, scrolling down).
Horizontal orientation (one item per column, scrolling right).
